syllabus_topics: Main characteristics of database systems, their architecture and development process.
Information modeling. Entity-Relationship and Relational Models. Conversion of E-R models to relational ones.
Languages for querying databases. Relational Algebra and Calculus. SQL.
Integrity Constraints. Referential integrity. Integrity in SQL.
Triggers. Architecture of database applications and their programming. Stored Procedures.
Data Normalization. Dependency Theory. Normal Forms, Decomposition and normalization of relational schemas.
Indexing Structures: B+ Tree. Hash Indexes. Bitmap Indexes.
Transaction Processing and Recovery in SQL.
Security and Access Control in Databases. Complex data and XML.
Decision support systems. Data warehousing. OLAP. Data mining methods.
Text search and indexing models. Evaluation of information retrieval systems.
assessment_rules: The final grade is 0.5 * (0.5 * Project Delivery 1 + 0.5 * Project Delivery 2 + Oral Discussion) + 0.5 * Max(Exam 1, Exam 2, Special Exam). A minimum final project grade of 8.0 and a minimum exam grade of 8.0 are required. For the special period, the assessment is identical, requiring the project to be completed within the normal period deadlines. Student-workers with formalized status can opt for an individual project, with a single delivery (E1+E2) by the E2 deadline and an oral discussion.
